source.return_convention: NAV purchase/sale with distributions reinvested at payment dates; broker commissions excluded
source.reading: Selected sections and filing index inspected, not full report

model_refusals: A one-period return difference is not tracking-error volatility
NAV return is not an investor executable market-price return
Do not equate displayed expense ratio with the entire tracking difference
Fund cash flows are not corporate free-cash-flow valuation; underlying holdings require a separate look-through method
failure_handling: Missing dated market-price/spread/premium data prevents an execution-cost conclusion
Do not backfill older cutoffs from current live issuer tables
